cases.question: What do conditionally selected applicants to the Biomedical Engineering Technology program have to complete before full acceptance?
cases.standalone_question: What do conditionally selected applicants to the Biomedical Engineering Technology program have to complete before full acceptance?
cases.answer_excerpt:
Conditionally selected applicants to the Biomedical Engineering Technology program must complete several specific requirements before receiving full acceptance.

* **Criminal Record Check:** Required under the British Columbia Criminal Records Review Act for students engaging with children and/or vulnerable adults during a practicum.
* **Immunization Review:** Must be completed and submitted to Student Health Services, as immunization is mandatory for the program.
* **Mandatory BMET Program Admission Forum:** Must attend one session before September to learn about the curriculum and career paths, meet faculty and students, tour labs, and ask questions.

Once these conditions and any other outstanding requirements are met, applicants will receive notification of their full acceptance.

Sources:

cases.question: What post-secondary courses are part of the Academic Foundations requirement for BCIT's full-time Bachelor of Science in Nursing?

cases.answer_excerpt:
To meet the Academic Foundations entrance requirements for BCIT's full-time Bachelor of Science in Nursing, applicants must complete 18.0 post-secondary credits with a minimum grade of 67% in each of the following required courses:

*   **ENGL 1177:** Academic Writing or an approved equivalent (3.0 credits). Note that this course can also satisfy the English language proficiency requirement.
*   **BHSC 1200:** Human Anatomy and Physiology or an approved equivalent, completed within the past three years (6.0 credits).
*   **PSYC 1101:** Introductory Psychology 1 or an approved equivalent (3.0 credits).
*   **General Education electives:** 100-level minimum courses across at least two different academic disciplines (6.0 credits).

All Academic Foundations courses must be completed before applying, and midterm grades are not accepted.

cases.question: If BCIT grants me transfer credit for a course, does my program tuition go down, and how must transcripts be submitted?
cases.standalone_question: If BCIT grants me transfer credit for a course, does my program tuition go down, and how must transcripts be submitted?
cases.answer_excerpt:
If BCIT grants you transfer credit, your full-time program tuition may not be reduced, though your course load will be lighter. For official transcripts required for transfer credits, they must be sent directly to BCIT from the previously attended institution(s) or dropped off in a sealed, stamped envelope.

Here are the details for each part:

*   **Tuition and Course Load:** When you receive individual course credit in a full-time program, your tuition is generally not reduced, but you will carry a lighter course load. 
*   **Transcript Submission:** Official transcripts for transfer credit evaluation must be sent directly from your previous institution(s) to BCIT, or dropped off in person in an original sealed, stamped envelope. Scans of transcripts are not accepted for this purpose.

Sources:

- https://www.bcit.ca/admission/tuition-fees/full-time-studies/

cases.question: money back if i withdraw after classes start?
cases.standalone_question: What is the refund policy if I withdraw from a course or program at BCIT after classes start?
cases.answer_excerpt:
You may be eligible for a tuition refund if you withdraw after classes start, provided you do so by the specific refund deadline for your program or course type. 

* **Full-Time Programs:** For most full-time programs, your latest acceptable withdrawal date to receive a refund is 10 business days after the start of class. Commitment fees are non-refundable and will be deducted from your refund.
* **Flexible Learning Courses:** Refund eligibility and deadlines depend on the course length and delivery format (such as classroom-based, blended, or distance learning). For example, courses lasting more than four weeks generally offer an 85% tuition refund if you withdraw prior to the second class or within two weeks of the course start date, depending on the format.
* **Apprenticeship Programs:** Refunds depend on how far in advance you cancel prior to the class start date. No refunds are issued for withdrawals made nine days or less before the start of class, or after the third day of class.
* **General Requirements:** To receive an eligible refund, you must submit a refund request form within two calendar years of the course start date. 

Sources:
- https://www.bcit.ca/admission/tuition-fees/refunds-withdrawals/
sub_queries: BCIT tuition refund policy withdrawal after classes start

cases.question: BCIT 간호 프로그램 입학하려면 뭐가 필요해?

  - **화학:** Chemistry 11 (73%)
  - **학업 기초(Academic Foundations):** 각 과목 최소 67% 이상으로 18.0 학점의 후기 중등(post-secondary) 과목 이수 (지원 전 모두 완료 필수, 중간 성적 불인정)

    - BHSC 1200 (Human Anatomy and Physiology) 또는 동등한 과정, 최근 3년 이내 이수 (6.0 학점)
    - PSYC 1101 (Introductory Psychology 1) 또는 동등한 과정 (3.0 학점)

  - 조건부 합격을 통보받은 경우, 범죄 경력 조회(Criminal Record Check)와 예방접종 기록(Immunization Records) 제출 등이 요구됩니다.
